title: The Tesla Roadster Event LIVE w/ Meet Kevin [Elon Musk Reveal!]
speaker: Meet Kevin (Kevin Paffrath)

macro_themes.view: With yields around 5.25-5.5%, large capital raises are making the market nervous.
Mega fundraises (SpaceX, Broadcom, Oracle) are 'sucking' money out of the market and contributed to the recent selloff.
Open-weight models let H100s run near-frontier AI cheaply, so older GPUs are rising in value, which benefits SpaceX's compute.
Roadster event is marketing for a Tesla-SpaceX combination; merger unlikely while both stock prices stay stable.

calls.condition: If QQQ bounces at the 715 line, buy the dip
calls.reason: Alpha report flagged 715 on QQQ as a bounce level; it bounced within 43 cents and he bought six figures of the dip.
calls.quote: If the market bounces, the Q's bounce at 7:15, buy. ... it was like 7:15 and 43 cents ... Bought. Six figs

calls.reason: Open-weight models make SpaceX's large H100 fleet appreciate rather than depreciate; re-underwrote and bought at ~132-135 support.
calls.quote: I turned bullish on SpaceX at around 132 bucks... bought more uh at about 135-ish cuz we've got a support line

notes: Transcript gives no date; event was the Roadster reveal rescheduled ~2 weeks after Oct 1, so listing date 2026-10-16 (approx) used. QQQ '7:15' read as $715 level. SpaceX ticker unknown, recorded as 'SPACEX'. TSLA discussed at length but no clear price bias (skeptical on Roadster 2028 production; cybercab validation speed is the catalyst), so no TSLA call.
